newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Mahathir to visit Kuwait, Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mahathir to visit Kuwait, Bahrain.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad will visit Kuwait and Bahrain in a trip starting on Saturday to boost business with the Gulf states, the national Bernama news agency reported on Thursday.

Kuwait's ambassador to Malaysia, Salim Jaber Al-Sabah, said the visit could lead to joint ventures in oil and gas between Malaysia's state-owned Petronas and the Kuwait Oil Company in third countries such as Vietnam and China.

The national news agency Bernama quoted the ambassador as saying Malaysia's state investment firm, Khazanah Holdings, and the Kuwait Investment Authority may work together on projects, but did not give details.

Mahathir will hold talks with Kuwaiti Prime Minister and Crown Prince Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah, who is hosting his visit and witness the signing of an agreement on avoidance of double taxation between Malaysia and the oil emirate.
In Bahrain, Mahathir will hold bilateral talks with Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Sulman al-Khalifa. He will also address the Gulf Economic Forum and a gathering of Bahrain bankers.
